name: io.github.paylod/mcp
description: OAuth-authenticated remote MCP server for paylod — let AI agents transact M-Pesa (STK push, payments, payouts, webhooks, QR, error decoding, sandbox simulation) through the paylod BaaS over Streamable HTTP.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: HTTP port the server listens on (default 8787). Sits behind Caddy at https://mcp.paylod.dev/mcp.

environmentVariables.name: PAYLOD_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: paylod backend edge-functions base URL (default https://paylod.dev/functions/v1).

environmentVariables.name: MCP_CANONICAL_URI
environmentVariables.description: Canonical resource URI / token audience (default https://mcp.paylod.dev/mcp).

environmentVariables.name: AS_JWKS_URI
environmentVariables.description: AS JWKS endpoint for ES256 verification (default https://paylod.dev/oauth/.well-known/jwks.json).
